description: This file is a shell library intended to facilitate testing of an HTTP server within a git testing environment. It contains setup routines, configuration, and utility functions for starting/stopping an HTTP server, managing SSL certificates, and simulating various HTTP test scenarios.

methods.name: install_script
methods.description: Writes a script file into the HTTPD root directory based on a template from the test directory.

methods.name: prepare_httpd
methods.description: Sets up the HTTP server directory structure, copies configuration files, and prepares SSL if enabled.

methods.name: enable_http2
methods.description: Enables HTTP/2 support in the server configuration.

methods.name: enable_cgipassauth
methods.description: Enables the CGIPassAuth feature if the server version supports it.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server with prepared configuration and environment.
